text:
sana: heads up — gitleaks alerted on a service account JSON committed in tests on branch feature/booking-tests. file: tests/fixtures/sa_test_key.json. unsure how long it's been there. any immediate containment steps?
security-bot: automated alert: rule=gitleaks:high confidence. match=Service Account JSON (private_key) in tests/fixtures/sa_test_key.json. first detected=1893456789. scan_id=gl-2026-987
alex: can you paste the file content (redact key) or at least the type/fingerprint?
sana: snippet: ```json
{
  "type": "service_account",
  "project_id": "redwood-dev",
  "private_key_id": "abcd1234efgh",
  "private_key": "-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----\nMII...REDACTED...\n-----END PRIVATE KEY-----",
  "client_email": "ci-test-sa@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}
```
mike: yikes. immediate steps: 1) revoke the key, 2) remove file from history, 3) rotate any KMS keys the SA had access to, 4) scan CI artifacts. @irina can you revoke now? :rotating_light:
irina: on it. I have IAM perms. revoking the exposed key now and will create a new key+least-privileged SA for tests. running: ```bash
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=ci-test-sa@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com
# identify key id abcd1234efgh -> delete
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete abcd1234efgh --iam-account=ci-test-sa@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```
irina: deleted key abcd1234efgh at 1893456890. creating replacement ephemeral key and updating secrets manager after scrub.
alex: thanks. we should assume the old key was used — search CI artifacts and logs for that private key id/fingerprint. commands: ```bash
gsutil cat gs://redwood-ci-artifacts/** | grep -E "abcd1234efgh|BEGIN PRIVATE KEY|ci-test-sa@redwood-dev"
# and locally
git grep -n "ci-test-sa@redwood-dev" -- '**/*' || true
git log --all --pretty=format:%H -- tests/fixtures/sa_test_key.json | xargs -n1 -I{} sh -c 'git show {}:tests/fixtures/sa_test_key.json' | grep -n "BEGIN PRIVATE KEY" || true
```
sana: i've kicked off a full repo-history scrub using git-filter-repo on a branch copy. command used: ```bash
git clone --mirror git@github.com:redwood/booking.git booking-mirror
cd booking-mirror
git filter-repo --path tests/fixtures/sa_test_key.json --invert-paths --force
# push back to a new scrubbed repo, coordinate with approvals
git remote add scrubbed git@github.com:redwood/booking-scrubbed.git
git push scrubbed --all --force
```
eng-oncall: creating internal incident INC-2026-45 (sev3) to track reprovision, scrub, audit, and customer impact assessment. ticket: https://linear.app/redwood/INC-2026-45
mike: make sure to notify GitHub support if the key was pushed to forks or public clones. also check code search indexes (sourcegraph) and our S3/gs artifact buckets for snapshots.
irina: checked KMS bindings — this SA had decrypt on a test KMS key (projects/redwood-dev/locations/global/keyRings/test/cryptoKeys/test-key). I'll rotate that key and revoke old versions. running rotation and will post changes to the ticket.
sana: added immediate repo safeguards: added pre-commit rule + gitleaks check to tests/requirements and CI: ```yaml
# .github/workflows/prepush.yml snippet
- name: Run gitleaks
  run: gitleaks detect --source . --report-format json || true
```
alex: also add a check in PR template and block merges until CI scan passes. follow-up: add automated secret scanning to the dedicated infra scanner and require branch protection.
mike: post-incident actions we agreed on: - enforce pre-commit/gitleaks org-wide - require scanning of artifact buckets weekly - audit all service accounts with lastKeyChange > 90d - add alert for SA JSON patterns in repo commits - run a retro w/ devex to improve test fixture practices (use ephemeral creds via workload identity / KMS-wrapped secrets)
sana: note: we should update docs with an example ephemeral fixture using workload identity. i'll draft.
irina: new test SA created: ci-test-sa-ephemeral@redwood-dev.iam.gserviceaccount.com, key never pushed to git, secrets in Secret Manager referenced by CI. added to ticket.
eng-oncall: status update: keys revoked, repo scrub in progress (pushed scrubbed repo to booking-scrubbed), artifact scan running, incident ticket updated.
sana: closing this thread when ticket INC-2026-45 is resolved and we confirm no external exposure. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
